name: Nils Ušakovs - § 56 - Am 64
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 56. Stresses that rising interest rates on NGEU loans are causing increasing budgetary instability; regrets that legislators did not foresee the long-term effects of taking out the NGEU loan; calls, in view of the difficult economic situation and in order to restore competitiveness, for work on new own resources, which are in fact further tax burdens on citizens and European businesses, to be halted; calls on the Council and the Member States to carry out, without further delay, an audit of EU expenditure in order to identify possible savings; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 30 Niinistö, S., ‘Safer Together – Strengthening Europe’s Civilian and Military Preparedness and Readiness’, 2024.
